description.zh:
是否自动付费，取值说明：

- **true**：（默认值）自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
- **false**：手动付费。具体操作，请参见[手动续费包年包月实例](~~85052~~)。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

- **true**: (Default) Enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

- **false**: Disables automatic payment. In this case, you must manually complete the payment. For more information, see [Manually renew a subscription instance](~~85052~~).

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. \`ClientToken\` can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The disk category. \`cloud\_essd\` indicates an Enhanced SSD (ESSD).

description.zh:
ESSD云盘的性能等级。取值范围：

- PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
- PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
- PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
- PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万。
description.en:
The performance level of the ESSD. Valid values:

- PL0: A single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.

- PL1: A single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.

- PL2: A single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.

- PL3: A single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.
The ID of the ECS instance.

description.zh:
迁移源要迁入的目标阿里云地域ID。

例如，您需要迁移源服务器至杭州，则相应的阿里云地域ID为`cn-hangzhou`。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en:
The ID of the destination Alibaba Cloud region.

For example, if you want to migrate a source server to the China (Hangzhou) region, the region ID is `cn-hangzhou`. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.
The ID of the resource group.
The ID of the destination vSwitch.
The ID of the destination zone.

title.zh: 创建跨可用区迁移任务

descriptions.zh: 关于跨可用区迁移的使用限制及其迁移影响等信息，请参见[跨可用区迁移操作](~~476797~~)。
descriptions.en: For more information about the limits and effects of cross-zone migration, see [Cross-zone migration](~~476797~~).
